name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Tuck your elbows snugly against your sides and brace your core.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping your palms down and wrists flat.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension under full control.
tips: Keep your knuckles aligned straight with your forearms rather than letting your wrists bend back.
Avoid swaying your torso or swinging your elbows forward to lift heavier loads.
